description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Wind Radiant Shield: 75%] to all allies, [Attach Wind], [Awoken Leap] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Awoken Leap
description.text: Dragoon and Dancer abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Dragoon and Dancer abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dragoon and Dancer abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Wind Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Wind damage capped at 9999

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%
